summary: This directory manages the core logic for architectural analysis, documentation generation, and structural metadata modeling, providing the primary infrastructure for understanding and documenting TypeScript project architectures.
responsibilities: Analyze project source structures and package exports
Construct and validate directory and package conceptual models
Orchestrate automated documentation generation and assembly
Manage project metadata storage and path resolution
Centralize system error handling and lifecycle tracking
relationships: The architectural analysis process constructs conceptual models from project file structures and package exports.
Documentation generation logic utilizes the derived conceptual models to assemble and populate structured project README files.
System-wide error handling provides contextual feedback during the execution of analysis and documentation workflows.
Metadata management ensures that generated concepts and documentation targets are correctly stored and resolved across the project lifecycle.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of analysis logic within internal functional modules
Separation of concerns between structural resolution and content generation
Use of schema-based validation for serialized architectural concepts
Modular isolation of documentation construction and rendering processes
Centralized error tracking using specialized subclasses and context interfaces
